messages:
maya: CI started failing on infra/gpu-provision matrix around 07:10 UTC — lots of flakes. job: infra/gpu-provision (matrix: gpu=[a100,v100], region=[us-west-2,eu-west-1])
chris: seeing the same. most failures are either 'capacity quota exceeded' from the cloud provider or runner disconnects mid-apply.
sre_liz: we had a quota cutover in us-west-2 on 2026-03-15, cloud support throttled some GPU allocations. they said it's rolling out but could be sticky. curious why GH Actions isn't bouncing to a fallback.
maya: paste logs: ```terraform apply -auto-approve
Error: Error creating instance: quota exceeded: GPUs
  on modules/gpu/main.tf line 12, in resource "aws_instance" "gpu":
 12: resource "aws_instance" "gpu" {```
chris: also saw runner logs with `connection reset by peer` right after provisioning attempted. cache restore then hangs because the runner disappears.
will: the matrix launches multiple provisioning jobs in parallel (strategy.matrix concurrency=3) so when quota gets tight we hammer the provider and see 429/quota errors. the cache restore (actions/cache) then gets intermittent 500s too.
maya: suggestion: reduce parallelism for gpu provisioning jobs, add a preflight quota check step, and wrap terraform apply in retry logic with exponential backoff.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rerun requested by @maya for infra/gpu-provision #3441 at 1789457000
chris: quick mitigation: in .github/workflows/provision.yml set `strategy: { max-parallel: 1 }` for gpu matrix and add a `preflight: check-quotas` step that calls `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-XXXXX` or `az vm list-usage` depending on provider.
paul: I pushed a tiny PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1124) that sets matrix max-parallel: 1 and adds a `preflight-quotas` step which fails fast if GPUs < 2. also bumped terraform lock retry to 10 with 15s backoff.
sre_liz: nice. also pin `actions/cache` to v4 and pin terraform provider versions — we've seen action updates change behavior mid-flight. add provider retry wrappers for vm create.
maya: reran the PR CI: eu-west-1 runs cleanly now, us-west-2 still sporadic with `quota exceeded` on one of the sizes. cloud says quota restore is staged, but soft-limits are still propagating.
will: another improvement: detect quota error string in apply and automatically set an env var `GPU_FALLBACK=true` to run a second apply with smaller instance type for non-prod only. cost tradeoff but keeps CI healthy.
chris: also observed that actions/cache restore returned HTTP 500 occasionally; switching to `actions/cache@v4` and adding `restore-keys` patterns fixed it on my branch.
maya: merging the max-parallel + preflight patch; will follow up to add fallback route and a post-merge monitor for 24h. if flakes persist, we should switch CI infra provisioning to the Dedicated pool for a while.
infra-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INFRA-6789 for GPU quota fallout, assigned to @sre_liz
maya: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the coordination thread. I'll post an update after 24h of runs. :thumbsup:
